One Line, Four Lights: final contact sheet (M5)

These are every frame of the final capture (docs/build/m2-after2, branch design/three-films), saved as small JPGs so the record opens anywhere. Desktop frames show the captioned version at 1440 px, downscaled to 640. Each film frame shows the final blind stranger test: 3 judges saw only the text-free blind version and guessed the film and the moment. A frame passes when at least 2 of the 3 judges named the intended film at a confidence of 0.6 or more. Frames with a yellow top edge were changed or re-captured in the M5 fix round (bc1072b) after the final test. Their thumbnail shows the new scene, but their verdict is for the old one.
